Corrected equation:
\[
(400+10a+3)+984 = 1300+10b+7
\]
\[
1387+10a = 1307+10b
\]
\[
10b-10a = 80 \implies b-a=8
\]

Since \(13b7\) is divisible by 11:
\[
(1+b)-(3+7)=b-9
\]
must be a multiple of 11. With \(b\) a digit, \(b=9\).

Then \(b-a=8 \implies 9-a=8 \implies a=1\).

Thus:
\[
a+b=1+9=\boxed{10}
\]
